visual_argument: A new manufacturing bay taped out for machines and lit only through its dock door, because power is what it waits for; the company's own targets are taped on that floor at one scale, half the floor gold for the end of 2026 and all of it for the end of 2027.
build_risk: A count painted on a dark floor dims outside the pool and can read as a pictogram grid: twenty kit machine_pads must read as ten gold and ten grey from a mezzanine on a long lens, staged as one subject, inside a TXT.interior bay whose back wall is replaced by a chassis dock_door opening onto the lastLight sky.
distinct_from_recent: No. 66 stood outside a city block at dusk; this deck is mostly inside an unpowered building lit only through its door. No. 67 was a floodlit weigh station around a kit structure under artificial light; here there is no artificial light at all, because the missing power is the subject. No. 68 was a caliche well pad around one industrial object; this is Gulf Coast epoxy, tilt wall and red oxide steel, and its measure is a taped floor and a staked lease edge.
